summary: Highest occupied molecular orbital amplitude on a grid, from a real RHF/UHF wavefunction.
description: Runs an SCF and writes the HOMO amplitude as a Gaussian cube registered to the input geometry. Refuses rather than rendering a field from an unconverged wavefunction: a decorative isosurface is indistinguishable from a real one on screen.

dimensionality.description: 3 ONLY. A 2D structure must not reach a 3D physics method — the coordinate space is part of the type, and molecule.embed is the explicit step that produces 3D. An implicit SMILES→3D inside a field method would report one method having run when two did.

basis.description: METHOD-SPECIFIC, deliberately. The global Basis union was already false: the physics daemon accepts def2-tzvp and this method does not. A closed union at the domain level asserts that every method shares one basis vocabulary, which is not true and was never true.

spin.description: Unpaired electrons. null means 'infer from electron parity', which is REFUSED for a transition metal whose ground state is not the closed-shell singlet parity implies — see refusals.

box.description: How the SERVER chose the box, which is a decision a client must be able to read rather than infer. These were undeclared until now and the frontend consumed them anyway, out of a flat `meta` dict that no schema governed — so a renderer depended on facts the contract did not promise, which is the drift this whole chain exists to remove.

iso_sized_for.description: The isovalue the box was GROWN to close. Separate from iso_fixed because they can disagree: a box sized to close a contour at one level is not evidence about another, and conflating them is how a clipped surface reads as a physical boundary.

contour_closes_in_box.description: Whether the drawn isosurface is closed inside the grid. False means the surface is CLIPPED by the box, and a clipped lobe looks exactly like a small one.

capped.description: The grid hit its point ceiling and was coarsened.

wall_seconds.description: Wall time the grid evaluation took.

single_signed.description: True when every value has the same sign, so no opposite-sign lobe exists. A renderer needs it to pick a one-sided colour ramp — a diverging ramp on a single-signed field spends half its range on values that cannot occur, and the map reads as though the missing half were merely small.

converged.description: Only true is representable in a SUCCESS output. An unconverged SCF is a refusal, not a result with a flag — a caller that has to check a boolean will eventually not check it.

model.description: WHICH MODEL produced the numbers, in machine-readable form. A caveat in prose travels as a warning; the model IDENTITY travels here, because a client comparing two fields must be able to establish they came from the same model without parsing English.

refusals.condition: the requested basis does not describe every element present
refusals.measured: 6-31g has no iodine ECP; without one, iodine runs all-electron and the potential is wrong by 58 kcal/mol with no error raised

refusals.condition: a transition metal is present and spin was not given
refusals.measured: electron parity implies a closed-shell singlet that is not the ground state; the previous vocabulary collapsed this into UNSUPPORTED, which reads as 'give up' rather than 'answer one question'

refusals.condition: plain DIIS stalls and the second-order (newton) rescue also fails to converge
refusals.measured: a field rendered from an unconverged wavefunction is visually indistinguishable from a converged one

refusals.condition: the pre-flight estimate exceeds compute_budget_seconds, or the in-loop watchdog fires
refusals.measured: estimate is 2.8 x 5.9e-9 x nao^4.03 seconds, fitted over 47 molecules on this box; the 2.8x safety factor is the measured underestimate in the middle of the range
beyond that, HF on this box is not interactive at any basis

warnings.meaning: The orbital energies are not quantitatively quotable at this basis.
warnings.measured: STO-3G ranks nitrobenzene as more electron-rich than benzene while def2-SVP ranks it last, and water's LUMO moves 12 eV between the two
